name: app_settings
description: Read or change Sara's own settings on this device, when the user asks, e.g. "turn off night mode", "listen 10 seconds longer after a reply", "speak through the kitchen speaker". Call with no changes to read the current values. Keys, tokens, the Home Assistant address and the Claude model are not here: only the user changes them in Settings.

changes.description: Settings to change, in order. Empty to only read them.

setting.description: wake_word_listening: true/false, whether Sara listens for her name (off: she hears only a tap on the panel, until the user turns it back on). wake_word: the name she answers to, empty for the default. follow_up_seconds: 0-60, how long she listens without the name after a reply. conversation_seconds: 30-600, how long a conversation stays open after a reply. night_mode: true/false, a dim clock and text-only replies at night. night_start_hour, night_end_hour: 0-23. speaker: the name of a media player from home_state that reads her replies, empty for this device. room: the room this device is in, a Home Assistant area name, empty for none.

value.description: The new value as text, e.g. "true", "25", "Kitchen speaker".
